# Almanac: Harbor View Condominium Association
Version: 2
Compiled: 2026-11-29
As of: 2026-11-29 (board local date)
Board folder: Board Documents
Sources: 17 processed, 0 excluded
Completeness: complete
Open conflicts: 1
Provisional items: 1
Model route: NAS local model

## At a glance

| Topic | Current rule | Since | Scheduled | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly fee and budget | $240 per unit per month | 2026-03-01 | none | adopted |
| Pets | Up to 2 pets per unit, registration required, dog weight limit removed | 2025-04-15 | none | adopted |
| Renovations and work hours | Mon to Fri 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Sat 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., no Sun or holidays | 2024-07-15 | none | adopted |
| Balconies and exterior fixtures | Fixtures need written approval; heat pumps allowed with conditions; barbecues prohibited (electric barbecues discussed, provisional) | 2019-05-01 | none | adopted |

| Parking | Guest parking up to 48 hours; one assigned space per unit | 2025-10-01 | none | adopted |

## Monthly fee and budget

Current rule: $240 per unit per month.
Effective: 2026-03-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026."

Superseded:
- 2025-03-01 to 2026-03-01: $225 per unit. Source: minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $225 per unit, effective March 1, 2025." (3-0)
- 2024-03-01 to 2025-03-01: $210 per unit. Source: minutes-2024-01-18.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $210 per unit, effective March 1, 2024." (3-0)
- Proposed, not adopted: $235 per unit. Source: agenda-2025-01-23.pdf: "Budget 2025: proposed monthly common charge of $235 per unit from March 1, 2025." Amended in minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "The proposed charge of $235 was amended."
- Corrected: $230 stated in notice-2025-02-10-fees.pdf: "From March 1, 2025 the monthly common charge will be $230 per unit." Correction in minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "the notice of February 10, 2025 stating $230 was in error. The adopted charge is $225 per unit."
- Informational, not a rule: newsletter-2025-12.pdf: "Many of you have asked whether charges will rise to $250 next year."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pets

Current rule: Up to 2 pets per unit. Registration with management is required. The 35-pound limit for dogs has been removed.
Effective: 2025-04-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is removed; registration with management is still required."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: One pet per unit; dogs may not exceed 35 pounds; all pets registered with management. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit may keep one (1) pet." and "Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds."

Sched

uled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Renovations and work hours

Current rule: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.; no work on Sundays or holidays.
Effective: 2024-07-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-06-12, motion carried 3-0; restated in notice-2024-07-01-renovation-hours.pdf
Evidence: minutes-2024-06-12.docx: "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024."
Evidence: minutes-2024-06-12.docx: "Work on Sundays and holidays remains prohibited. Weekday hours are unchanged."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2024-07-15: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; no work on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No work is permitted on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Balconies and exterior fixtures

Current rule: No fixtures, appliances or equipment on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval. Heat pump outdoor units are permitted on balconies with written board approval if they are floor-mounted, not attached to the railing, and rated at no more than 60 dB(A). Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies.
Effective: 2019-05-01 (fixtures and barbecues); 2025-01-23 (heat pumps, decision date)
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01 (fixtures and barbecues); board meeting minutes, 2025-01-23, vote recorded 2-1 (heat pumps)
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No fixtures, appliances or equipment may be mounted on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies."
Evidence: minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "heat pump outdoor units are permitted on balconies with written board approval, provided they are floor-mounted and not attached to the railing, and have a rated sound level of no more than 60 dB(A)."

Superseded: none recorded.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional:
- Electric barbecues. board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a at 00:01:10: "So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight." No vote was taken. The recording says a motion was planned for the September agenda; no adopted minutes in the folder record one. Barbecues remain prohibited under the adopted rule.

## Quiet hours

Current rule: Friday and Saturday nights 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.; all other nights 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
Effective: 2026-10-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-09-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-09-15.docx: "amend House Rule 6 so that quiet hours on Friday and Saturday nights are 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m."
Evidence: minutes-2026-09-15.docx: "Quiet hours on all other nights remain 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Effective October 1, 2026. Motion carried 3-0."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2026-09-30, for Friday and Saturday nights only: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night."

Scheduled: none (the effective date of 2026-10-01 has passed)
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Rentals and leasing

Current rule: Minimum lease term is thirty (30) days.
Effective: 2025-04-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, vote recorded 2-1
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "amend House Rule 8 so that the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately. Motion carried 2-1."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: Minimum lease term six (6) months. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Units may not be leased for a term of less than six (6) months."
- Failed, not adopted: leases of seven (7) days or more. Source: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "permit leases of seven (7) days or more. Motion failed 1-2."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Parking

Current rule: Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Each unit has one assigned space.
Effec

tive: 2025-10-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit has one assigned space."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-09-30: Guest vehicles no more than 72 hours. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 72 hours."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Electric vehicle charging

Current rule: Owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost.
Effective: 2026-01-20 (decision date; no effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost."

Superseded: none recorded.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pool and amenities

Current rule: Conflict. For the 2026 season the documents disagree on hours: 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily, or 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily. Outside the 2026 season, the 2019 rule applies: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15.
Effective: 2026 season (decision date 2025-09-10 for the 10:00 p.m. hours)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.). Notice of 2026-05-01 gives 9:00 p.m.; a notice does not replace an adopted resolution.
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily. Motion carried 3-0."
Evidence: notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The pool is open 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15."

Superseded:
- Before the 2026 season: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf (quoted above).

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts:
- 2026 season hours. minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily." notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." No document resolves this.
Provisional:
- board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a at 00:01:45: "Someone said the notice says nine pm, but I thought we said ten." Objection recorded; deferred. No adopted minutes record a decision on it.

## Vendor contracts

Current rule: Landscaping services are provided by Bramblewick Grounds LLC under the agreement signed 2024-01-25 for April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026, at $1,450 per month. The agreement renews automatically for one-year terms unless written notice of non-renewal is given at least 60 days before the end of the term, and any renewal increase is capped at 4%. The board decided on 2025-09-10 that the Association will not renew at the end of the term. A non-renewal notice is dated 2026-02-02, after the 2026-01-30 date set in the minutes. Whether the agreement ended is not established by the documents.
Effective: 2024-04-01 (start of term)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-01-18, motion carried 3-0 (award); contract signed 2024-01-25; board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (non-renewal)
Evidence: minutes-2024-01-18.pdf: "award the landscaping contract to Bramblewick Grounds LLC on the terms of the attached agreement, for the period April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026. Motion carried 3-0."
Evidence: contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf: "The Client pays the Contractor $1,450 per month."
Evidence: contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf: "renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current ter

m."
Evidence: contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf: "On each renewal the monthly fee may increase by no more than four percent (4%)."
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "the Association will not renew the Bramblewick Grounds agreement at the end of its term."
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "The Secretary is to send written notice of non-renewal by January 30, 2026. Motion carried 3-0."
Evidence: email-2026-02-02-landscaping.txt: "Please accept this message as written notice that Harbor View Condominium Association will not renew the Landscaping Services Agreement that ends on March 31, 2026."

Superseded: none.

Scheduled: none stated
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none
Status: incomplete. The deadline and the date of the notice are recorded; the outcome is not established.

## Officers and elections

Current rule: The board has three directors: President, Treasurer and Secretary; a quorum is two directors. The Treasurer resigned, and a new Treasurer was appointed on 2025-09-10 to serve until the next annual meeting.
Effective: 2025-09-10 (decision date)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "The Treasurer resigned. The board appointed a new Treasurer to serve until the next annual meeting. Motion carried 3-0."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The Association is governed by a board of three directors: a President, a Treasurer and a Secretary. A quorum is two directors."

Superseded: none recorded.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Governance and amendments

Current rule: Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds vote of unit owners at an annual meeting. House rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board. The house-rule amendments in the minutes were recorded as board votes; this almanac does not rule on whether they met the threshold.
Effective: 2019-05-01
Set by: Bylaws and house rules adopted by unit owners, 2019-05-01
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "These Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting."
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The House Rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board."

Superseded: none recorded.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Changelog

## v2, 2026-11-29
- Rebuilt from 17 files (16 documents and 1 recording). New since v1: minutes-2026-09-15.docx.
- Changed: Quiet hours. Friday and Saturday nights now 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., effective 2026-10-01 (minutes-2026-09-15.docx, motion carried 3-0). Other nights unchanged at 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Previously 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night.
- Unchanged: pool conflict for the 2026 season; landscaping status incomplete; electric barbecue item provisional.
- Open items: none added, closed or dropped.
- New conflicts: none. Open conflicts: 1 (Pool and amenities). Provisional items: 1 (electric barbecues). Exclusions: none.

End of almanac v2.
